ex.en: The earthquake caused heavy casualties in the mountain villages.
ex.zh: 地震在山区村庄造成重大伤亡。

words.note: casualty 常用复数 casualties，指伤亡人员或牺牲者。

ex.en: It is hard to gauge public opinion from such a small sample.
ex.zh: 仅凭这么小的样本很难判断民意。

words.note: gauge 作动词意为「判断、估计」；美式也拼作 gage。

ex.en: The museum has a fine collection of oriental art.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆藏有一批精美的东方艺术品。

words.note: oriental 现多指「东方文化的」；指人时宜改用 Asian。

ex.en: All electrical equipment must be checked before use.
ex.zh: 所有电气设备使用前都必须检查。

words.note: electrical 修饰设备；electric 多修饰具体电器，如 fan。

ex.en: The negotiators stalled for time while waiting for new instructions.
ex.zh: 谈判者拖延时间，等待新的指示。

words.note: stall 指「(引擎)熄火」「拖延」；名词指「货摊」。

ex.en: Hundreds of workers protested against the plan to close the factory.
ex.zh: 数百名工人抗议关闭工厂的计划。

words.note: protest against/about 表「抗议某事」；名词重音在前。

ex.en: Children are especially sensitive to changes in their parents' mood.
ex.zh: 孩子对父母情绪的变化尤其敏感。

words.note: be sensitive to 是固定搭配；sensible 意为「明智的」。

ex.en: The classification of these species has long puzzled biologists.
ex.zh: 这些物种的分类长期令生物学家困惑。

words.note: classification 源自 classify：classify A as B。

ex.en: She brewed a fresh pot of tea for her guests.
ex.zh: 她为客人新泡了一壶茶。

words.note: brew 原指酿酒、泡茶，引申为「风暴、麻烦酝酿」。

ex.en: There were no vacant seats left in the hall.
ex.zh: 大厅里已经没有空座位了。

words.note: vacant 指「无人占用的」；empty 指「空的、无内容的」。

ex.en: Drunk drivers are a menace to everyone on the road.
ex.zh: 醉酒司机威胁着路上每个人的安全。

words.note: menace 常用 a menace to sb/sth；动词意为「威胁」。

ex.en: We cannot afford to waste any more time on this issue.
ex.zh: 我们不能再在这个问题上浪费时间了。

words.note: afford 多与 can、could 连用，后接名词或不定式。

ex.en: Your ticket becomes invalid if you do not use it on the stated date.
ex.zh: 车票若未在指定日期使用即失效。

words.note: 表「无效的」读 /ɪnˈvælɪd/；指病人时读 /ˈɪnvəlɪd/。

ex.en: The team seems to be cursed with injuries this season.
ex.zh: 本赛季这支队似乎总被伤病困扰。

words.note: curse 可数：put a curse on sb；动词直接接宾语。

ex.en: Parents have legitimate concerns about the safety of online learning.
ex.zh: 家长对线上学习的安全有合理的担忧。

words.note: legitimate 兼指「合法的」与「合情合理的」。

ex.en: The government tried to appease the angry farmers with new subsidies.
ex.zh: 政府试图用新的补贴安抚愤怒的农民。

words.note: appease 常含「姑息」的贬义，注意语境；近义 pacify。

ex.en: Sieve the flour into a large bowl before adding the eggs.
ex.zh: 加鸡蛋之前先把面粉筛进大碗里。

words.note: sieve 作名词指「筛子」，作动词与 sift 同义。

ex.en: They set up a scheme whereby students can borrow laptops for free.
ex.zh: 他们设立了一个让学生免费借用笔记本电脑的方案。

words.note: whereby 相当于 by which，多用于正式文体。

ex.en: Teachers evaluate students' progress at the end of each term.
ex.zh: 教师在每学期末评估学生的进步。

words.note: evaluate 比 judge 正式；名词为 evaluation。

ex.en: Education is often seen as a way to improve social status.
ex.zh: 教育常被视为提高社会地位的途径。

words.note: 常见搭配 social status、marital status；复数少用。

ex.en: The factory has invested heavily in new machinery.
ex.zh: 这家工厂在新型机械上投入巨大。

words.note: machinery 是不可数集合名词，一件机器说 a machine。

ex.en: The high walls shield the garden from the cold north wind.
ex.zh: 高墙使花园免受寒冷的北风侵袭。

words.note: shield 常用 shield sb/sth from sth，from 不能省。

ex.en: He often skips breakfast when he is in a hurry.
ex.zh: 他赶时间时常常不吃早饭。

words.note: skip 指「跳过、略过」；skip class 是逃课。

ex.en: The new system gives an almost instantaneous response to every request.
ex.zh: 新系统对每个请求几乎都能即时响应。

words.note: instantaneous 强调「瞬间」，语气比 immediate 强。

ex.en: Migration to big cities is a social phenomenon in many countries.
ex.zh: 向大城市迁移是许多国家的社会现象。

words.note: 复数为 phenomena；也可指「非凡的人或事」。

ex.en: The company publishes a quarterly report on its sales.
ex.zh: 公司每季度发布一份销售报告。

words.note: quarterly 由 quarter 加 -ly 构成，可作形容词或副词。

ex.en: Please notify the office of any change of address.
ex.zh: 地址如有变动，请通知办公室。

words.note: notify 常用 notify sb of sth 或 that 从句。

ex.en: Every research paper should include a bibliography at the end.
ex.zh: 每篇研究论文末尾都应附参考书目。

words.note: bibliography 指参考书目；biography 是「传记」。

ex.en: A steady stream of visitors came to see the exhibition.
ex.zh: 参观展览的人络绎不绝。

words.note: a stream of 表「一连串」，如 a stream of complaints。

ex.en: The same problem recurred a few months later.
ex.zh: 几个月后同样的问题又出现了。

words.note: recur 的形容词 recurring 常修饰 problem、theme。
